name: @sync-engine/core
description: A comprehensive Bun library for robust synchronization between client-side state management and SurrealDB with real-time collaboration features

scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:types && bun run build:bundle
scripts.build:adapters: bun build src/adapters/index.ts --outdir dist/adapters --target bun --format esm --outfile index.js && bun build src/adapters/index.ts --outdir dist/adapters --target node --format cjs --outfile index.cjs
scripts.build:middleware: bun build src/middleware/index.ts --outdir dist/middleware --target bun --format esm --outfile index.js && bun build src/middleware/index.ts --outdir dist/middleware --target node --format cjs --outfile index.cjs
scripts.build:schema: bun build src/schema/index.ts --outdir dist/schema --target bun --format esm --outfile index.js && bun build src/schema/index.ts --outdir dist/schema --target node --format cjs --outfile index.cjs
scripts.build:features: bun build src/features/index.ts --outdir dist/features --target bun --format esm --outfile index.js && bun build src/features/index.ts --outdir dist/features --target node --format cjs --outfile index.cjs

author: Sync Engine Team
